gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kosugi: Distinctive from the first glance, Sniglet stops its stroke ends short of curling back in, while Kosugi follows in a plain sans with a bent-wire look. One makes a statement; the other just gets on with it.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kosugi-maru: Sniglet is a display face with a quiet, level beat and terminals that stop short of curling back in, set over Kosugi Maru's glowing tube letters. Text in that sans would run smooth and light.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kumbh-sans: Sniglet brings a commanding display voice with no accents of weight, and Kumbh Sans sits beneath it, drawn like a fixed pen. The heading makes the entrance; the sans-serif body does the explaining.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-lato: Commanding is how Sniglet comes across, a laser-cut sheet look with one cutting width throughout. Lato follows with wide s curves barely curled in, which is the quality that holds the two together.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-line-seed-jp: Approachable and level, LINE Seed JP makes horizontals exactly as heavy as verticals, with counters that let the eye slip in and out. Sniglet earns its keep up top, big and short, where its stroke ends stop before curling back.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-livvic: Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling back in. Livvic, a sans-serif with no stress in its curves and a generous opening in c, would read smoothly and approachably across a longer page.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-lunasima: Sniglet is a display face where every stroke ends at the same measured thickness, giving a quiet, level beat. Lunasima keeps c tips that never creep toward touching, so the plain sans below feels tidy under it.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: Round, bold and hairline-free, Sniglet has no thin strokes anywhere in its alphabet and speaks with a display voice. But LXGW Marker Gothic does the quieter job, its hairlines only somewhat lighter than stems in a sans with a bracelet-wide c.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-m-plus-1: Distinctive in its level, accent-free beat, Sniglet lets its terminals stop short of curling back in. M PLUS 1 is the sans with big open eyes on every e and a, built for the steady reading.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-m-plus-1p: Wire-like and monoline, Sniglet is a display face with a distinct, commanding look. M PLUS 1p carries the plain sans job, keeping openness at every curve end for the sentences that follow.
